verdict.rationale: Bevy is a Rust game-engine library, not an editor application, and community feedback explicitly notes the lack of an integrated editor akin to Godot's (bevy-comm-6, bevy-comm-7); no evidence shows any documented scriptable interface for driving scenes/nodes/builds programmatically, and probes for docs/API endpoints return 404s (bevy-probe-1, bevy-probe-2, bevy-probe-3).
